snippet.title: No Walls In Heaven - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3937330/No_Walls_In_Heaven/

Eva's life of crime has caught up with her. Exiled from her syndicate and pursued by both the law and the ruthless criminal underworld, she faces a desperate gamble: infiltrate the enigmatic Husk for a slim chance at redemption - to save a life instead of take one. This colossal megastructure, appearing sporadically within the gravity well of a gas giant, is said to hold secrets beyond human comprehension... and no one who's ventured inside has ever returned.
